role: Synthetic institution forecasts for the current and next oil main contracts, with immutable half-month vintages and realized-only scoring.

capability_total_score.note: Weighted summary of the six configured radar dimensions.

invariants: the forecast covers only the current main and next-main named contracts
the continuous main series remains non-tradable and is never a forecast target
each vintage predicts only weeks after its half-month information cutoff
forecast OHLC always satisfies low <= min(open, close) <= max(open, close) <= high
ordinary forecast output contains no hidden actual future bars
scores use only weeks realized by the evaluation cutoff
historical vintages remain immutable so later revisions cannot overwrite prior forecasts
the forecast and its scores never write back to oil prices, liquidity, macro rows, or player positions
